item.title: Charli xcx artfully encapsulates pining, passion, misery in cinematic new album ‘Wuthering Heights’
item.description: Move over, Brat summer — it’s time for Brontë winter. item.title: Milwaukee Police Department suspends facial recognition amid public concerns
item.description: The Milwaukee Police Department recently paused its use of facial recognition technology while it drafts a formal policy governing the tool, according to Wisconsin Public Radio. Milwaukee officials have said the technology was used to generate investigative leads in violent felony cases, according to WPR.
